scope: Theorem 1.1 (Joint Liouville spectral limit) of the manuscript “Spectral convergence for critical FK–Ising planar maps” (preprints/Spectral-convergence-for-critical-FK-Ising-planar-maps-October-5-2026/spectral-convergence-critical-fk-ising-planar-maps.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 211 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 eeb5895c7058765f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The form (1.5) is closable on L2(µh). Its closure has compact resolvent, has the constants as its one-dimensional kernel, and satisfies Hh(t) < ∞ for every t > 0. As n → ∞ through all positive integers, ((Vn, andn, µn), (nλn,j)j≥0, Hn) =⇒  (S2 , Dh, µh), (Λj(h))j≥0, Hh  . (1.8) The first coordinate has the Gromov–Hausdorff–Prokhorov topology on isometry classes of compact metric probability spaces. The second has the product topology on [0, ∞]N0 . The third has Cloc((0, ∞)), the topology of uniform convergence on each [δ, T] with 0 < δ < T < ∞. All three limiting coordinates are constructed from the same quantum sphere h.
